title: Presunto à Ingleza (English-Style Ham)
description: Prepared with saltpeter, bay leaf, and berries.

ingredients.name: half pound of ground Indian pepper
four ounces of Indian pepper in grain
four ounces of juniper berries in grain
four pounds of molasses or muscovado sugar

steps: After cutting two hams, round them and cut the trimmings around them
Prick the skin with the tip of a knife so that the seasoning can penetrate them
Place ten pounds of salt, half pound of ground Indian pepper, and four ounces of saltpeter on a table
After rubbing them with this mixture, place them in a small tub, putting the rest of the salt on top, and leave them there for seven days

After this time, remove them, bring the brine to a boil, composed of water and the blood that came from the ham, skim well, and add serpol, bay leaf, two ounces of ginger, four ounces of Indian pepper in grain, the same amount of juniper berries in grain, marjoram, sage, oregano, and four pounds of molasses or muscovado sugar
Place the hams back in the tub, and when the brine is cold, pour it over them, and if it is not sufficient to cover the hams, add water and salt
Place a board with any weight on top to keep them in this brine for three weeks
After this time, remove them and place them in a press for twelve hours, and after draining, hang them in smoke
When they have taken on a beautiful color, rub them with wine mixed with vinegar to protect them from flies, then dry them for preservation

title: Presunto à Mineira (Ham Miner's Style)

ingredients.name: wine and vinegar in equal parts

steps: Take a ham leg, and after cutting and trimming it well, place it in a deep vessel covered with fresh water, keeping it there for three to four days

ingredients.name: a handful of bread crumb or dried rusks

steps: Put a little butter in a casserole with a slice of ham, three chives, one clove of garlic, summer savory, marjoram and bay leaf; place the casserole over a low heat and let it take heat for a quarter of an hour

title: Vacca de Fumaça à Hamburgueza (Smoked Beef Hamburg-style)
description: Prepared with beef, brown sugar, and onions.
steps: Remove the bones from the beef
